text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I really wanna know what happens 
next in the drama! But training starts 
soon...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Being just a little late is fine, 
right...? Just a few more minutes, just a 
few more!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's someone right behind you! 
Who is it!? Next story, next story~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle got engrossed in videos and 
ended up slacking off on her training.
